Is the detected table actually the table?

Each frame has the detected table drawn on it, with every bounce the ball made within 25 seconds either side scattered on top. If the quad is right, the yellow dots sit on it. If they sit somewhere else, the quad is wrong and the low shape reading is a calibration failure rather than a badly placed camera.

detected table + corners net line it implies bounce-cloud core, its axis and midpoint where the ball actually bounced
